metadata.title: CV
metadata.description: Adamu Danjuma Abubakar’s CV covers Francophone African literature, digital humanities, Hausa speech technology, multilingual AI evaluation, and French teaching.

name: Adamu Danjuma Abubakar
headline: Computational linguist and scholar of Francophone Africa
summary: I study how French and Sango interact in the novels of Central African writer Adrienne Yabouza. My digital humanities work makes multilingual oral-history collections easier to find. At Murya, I lead the linguistic design of a Hausa speech system, from the pitch of a syllable to the words used to address a listener respectfully.
location: Based in Tuscaloosa, Alabama · Open to relocation worldwide and remote work

experience.title: Founder and Linguistic Lead, Murya
experience.summary: Lead the linguistic design and product direction of a Hausa speech platform. Work with engineers on pronunciation, syllable weight, pitch, and respectful forms of address.
bullets: Curated and released 20,628 Hausa–English pairs from Robinson’s 1914 dictionary. Secured permission to use Paul Newman’s 1977 dictionary for internal lookup.

experience.title: AI Linguistic Specialist, contract
experience.summary: Evaluate multilingual language models in low-resource African languages. Rank competing responses, review their cultural appropriateness, and test model behavior through red-teaming.

experience.title: Graduate Researcher and Teaching Fellow, University of Alabama
experience.summary: Teach elementary and intermediate French as instructor of record, in person and online. Design curricula and professional French modules.
bullets: Research Central African women’s writing and French–Sango language contact. Study Nana Asma’u bint Fodio’s poetry in Hausa, Fulfulde, and Arabic, including the translation of Ajami texts into French.

datasets.title: Mapping Voices: An Open Atlas of Oral-History and Voice-Testimony Collections
datasets.meta: Dataset (v0.4.0) · Zenodo · CC BY 4.0 · Creator & curator · [doi:10.5281/zenodo.22996478](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22996478)
datasets.description: Created a searchable atlas of 221 oral-history and voice-testimony collections across 120 countries and territories. The dataset records 125 languages and links each collection to its holding institution. Published the data, classification methods, and revision history for reuse.

datasets.title: Murya: Hausa speech synthesis and lexicography
datasets.description: The eight-speaker system reads Hausa aloud offline after the model is loaded. Its acoustic tuning targets Standard Kano Hausa. An ongoing blind listening study asks listeners to rate how natural the voices sound.
